article.title: Punishment not to be imposed in certain cases.
article.content: No person shall be punishable for any failure referred to in section 476 or 477, irrespective of anything contained in that section, if he proves that there was reasonable cause for such failure.
article.html:
486Punishment not to be imposed in certain cases.

Section 486 · Chapter XXII · page 572 of the Act

No person shall be punishable for any failure referred to in section 476 or 477, irrespective of anything contained in that section, if he proves that there was reasonable cause for such failure.
